verdict.rationale: The pack only glancingly supports this story. First-party pages show a Sales Cloud "Dashboard view" and promise "complete visibility into your pipeline" with "Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management," which suggests built-in pipeline reporting inside the CRM rather than a spreadsheet. Nothing documents a user-facing report or dashboard builder, or reporting on activity and conversion. missing for 10: documented report/dashboard builder, activity reporting, conversion/funnel reporting, evidence of custom dashboard creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Dashboard view of Sales Cloud with an overlay to zoom in on AI-generated lead scoring within a CRM view.
Get complete visibility into your pipeline.
